requestedText: Add the validation interface registration companion test.

evidence: The companion test is a compile-time Rust test with no runtime loading, reflection, plugin lookup, or dynamic dispatch registration.
The companion test is repository-local and adds no external consumer or transport adapter.
The companion test adds no telemetry, monitoring, delivery, HTTP, scheduler, or provider integration.
The Contract authorizes this additive companion test within the validation interface boundary and excludes runtime, provider, production, and external-consumer changes.
